missions.name: Dead Stock by Category
missions.query: What are the product categories with stock count zero and retail price greater than $50?

missions.name: Supplier Lead Time Anomalies
missions.query: Which suppliers have a lead time greater than 30 days and on-time rate less than 90%?

missions.name: Reorder Point Breaches
missions.query: What products have a stock count below their reorder point and no restocking planned within the next 30 days?

missions.name: Sizing Anomalies by Color
missions.query: For each product size, what are the average stock counts by color, and are there any sizes with significantly low stock counts across all colors?

missions.name: Supplier Delay Impact on Sales
missions.query: For each supplier, what is the average delay in days between the last restocked date and the sale date, and are there any suppliers with significantly high average delays?

missions.name: Retail Price Variance
missions.query: What are the product categories with a retail price variance greater than 20% across different locations?

missions.name: Inventory Turnover by Channel
missions.query: For each sales channel, what is the average inventory turnover ratio, and are there any channels with significantly low turnover ratios?

missions.name: Supplier Risk Assessment
missions.query: For each supplier, what is the average lead time, on-time rate, and country of origin, and are there any suppliers with significantly high risk profiles?

missions.name: Dead Stock Identification
missions.query: Find products with stock count less than 5 across all locations and categorize them by category, size, and color

missions.name: Supplier Lead Time Analysis
missions.query: Identify suppliers with a lead time greater than 30 days and calculate the average on-time rate for each supplier

missions.name: Sizing Anomalies Detection
missions.query: Detect products with inconsistent size patterns across different locations (e.g., different sizes available in the same location)

missions.name: Reorder Point Breach Analysis
missions.query: Find products with a stock count below the reorder point and identify the products that have been in this state for more than 7 days

missions.name: Sales Channel Performance Comparison
missions.query: Analyze sales performance across different sales channels (e.g., online, offline) and identify the top-performing channels for each product category

missions.name: Inventory Turnover Rate Calculation
missions.query: Calculate the inventory turnover rate for each product and supplier, and identify products with a turnover rate less than 4 times per year

missions.name: Product Categorization Review
missions.query: Review product categorization and identify products that do not fit into their assigned categories based on style_name and category

missions.name: Supplier On-Time Rate Analysis
missions.query: Analyze the on-time rate for each supplier and identify suppliers with an on-time rate less than 80%
